name: How quickly should a school respond to water damage?

mainEntity.name: How quickly should a school respond to water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Immediate action is critical when water damage occurs in a school. Water can quickly penetrate building materials, leading to accelerated deterioration and potential mold growth within 24-48 hours. A rapid response helps minimize structural damage, reduces remediation costs, and ensures a healthier environment for students and staff. Contacting a professional restoration company within hours of discovery is ideal to begin water extraction and drying processes promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schools should respond immediately to water damage, ideally within hours. This prevents extensive structural damage and mold growth, which can start within 24-48 hours.
